latest_release.name: rustler-0.39.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Add Elixir 1.20 by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/744
* Fix Windows callback-table order for enif_set/is_pid_undefined by @ldgabbay in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/748
* Enforce panic unwind by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/747
* Go back to pre-generating all API snippets by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/749
* Update num-bigint requirement from 0.4 to 0.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/752
* Update syn requirement from 2.0 to 3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/753
* Add hashing for LocalPid by @evnu in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/756
* Change hash_internal to return u64 by @rkallos in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/758
* Implement `From<&[u8]>` for binary by @hauleth in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/757
* Use NewBinary for string encoding by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/760
* Make from_slice methods non-generic by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/762
* Add direct symbol references back by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/764
* Handle allocation errors in the same way for all types by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/761
* ERL_NIF_TERM as newtype by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/766
* Fixes for warnings on nightly Rust by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/767
* RFC: Drop rustler::wrapper by @filmor in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/768

## New Contributors
* @ldgabbay made their first contribution in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/748
* @rkallos made their first contribution in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/758
* @hauleth made their first contribution in https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/pull/757

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rusterlium/rustler/compare/rustler-0.38.0...rustler-0.39.0
